disclosure: This is a post-v6, result-known, versioned multi-source systematic scoping evidence map. It is not a prospective preregistration, an exhaustive internet census, or a meta-analysis. R5 is a compliance-only role correction made after the R4 OOF: the explicitly predeclared distance-technical-debt rule is enforced without using labels or predictions to change any primary indicator, model, fold, threshold, or parameter. The corrected registry is frozen before the complete R5 OOF rerun.
selection_principle: Admit every source-backed, publication-time, locally reproducible, sufficiently covered and reference-subsampling-stable mathematical family; retain only one primary implementation per family and choose without OOF. Close variants may enter sensitivity analysis only when their candidate-specific protocol does not require exclusion; the first-time source-pair distance technical debt remains excluded unless it passes the fixed coverage gates.

A1_COMBINATION_RARITY.meaning: The observed rarity or surprise of co-cited knowledge-source pairs relative to their strictly prior marginal prevalence.
A1_COMBINATION_RARITY.inclusion_rule: Include a paper-level rarity statistic with an explicit observed/expected or prior-overlap formula, T0 history, and independent application or validation.
A1_COMBINATION_RARITY.exclusion_rule: Exclude threshold-only variants, monotone transforms, and any similarity reference set that is not frozen before publication.

A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.meaning: The unusual left tail and conventional centre of the focal paper's distribution of source-pair null-model z scores.
A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.inclusion_rule: Include the source-defined P10 novelty and median conventionality facets when the frozen null approximation matches its exact reference implementation.
A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.exclusion_rule: Exclude arbitrary quantiles, duplicate standardizations, and null models without convergence or exact-reference checks.

A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.meaning: Whether and how strongly a paper joins knowledge-source pairs absent from the strictly prior literature.
A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.inclusion_rule: Include ex-ante first-occurrence statistics whose denominator and history are explicit and contain no future reuse.
A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.exclusion_rule: Exclude future-confirmed reuse from T0, reference-count-dominated duplicates, and distance statistics below coverage/stability thresholds.

A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.meaning: The number, relative spread, and balance of scientific categories represented in a paper's strictly prior references.
A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.inclusion_rule: Retain theoretically distinct variety and balance families with paper-level scientometric use; choose one interpretable and stable representative within each family.
A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.exclusion_rule: Exclude strict monotone rescalings, algebraic complements, and multiple Hill orders as separate primary degrees of freedom.

A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.meaning: The cognitive disparity among referenced fields and the degree to which disparate fields are jointly integrated.
A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.inclusion_rule: Retain an unweighted distance component and at most one share-weighted composite; require frozen pre-publication distance profiles.
A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.exclusion_rule: Exclude duplicate composites, future-trained semantic spaces, and graph measures lacking scalable formula fidelity or local coverage.

A1.NOVELTY_U.missing_definition: Null with fewer than two mapped sources or without a historical denominator.
A1.NOVELTY_U.decision_reason: Provisional v6 core; primary admission awaits frozen v6.1 coverage, stability, and formula-reference checks.

A1.MEAN_SURPRISAL.missing_definition: Null without valid historical pair commonness values.
A1.MEAN_SURPRISAL.decision_reason: The arithmetic mean of transformed commonness is a transparent project-defined distribution summary, but Lee et al. define the lower-tail Novelty U rather than this mean. It therefore lacks a peer-reviewed original formula and paper-level application as this exact statistic and cannot enter the primary or sensitivity model.

A1.LOW_FREQUENCY_SHARE.missing_definition: Null with fewer than two mapped sources.
A1.LOW_FREQUENCY_SHARE.decision_reason: The count threshold is a project choice rather than a uniquely source-defined paper-level formula.

A1.REFERENCE_OVERLAP.knowledge_unit: focal reference set versus prior same-domain papers sharing at least one reference

parameters.comparison_scope: strictly prior records in the complete frozen Nature v5 background sharing at least one reference and the same frozen OpenAlex primary field
parameters.taxonomy_adaptation: Matsumoto exact subject-category matching implemented with the frozen OpenAlex primary-field taxonomy
parameters.corpus_scope_adaptation: Matsumoto comparison universe restricted to the complete locally frozen Nature v5 target background

A1.REFERENCE_OVERLAP.missing_definition: Null without a valid strictly prior bibliography or an eligible prior same-field Nature-background comparison record.
required_data: strictly prior same-domain Nature-background reference lists
A1.REFERENCE_OVERLAP.decision_reason: R4 uses a window pattern explicitly evaluated in the source: all strictly prior references and all strictly prior co-citing papers. It is the last source-defined window revision, selected without labels after the 10-year/3-year R3 variant failed the fixed mathematics/statistics coverage gate. Formula, same-domain conditions and local corpus remain unchanged; the OpenAlex-taxonomy and Nature-background adaptations are disclosed. Primary admission still requires every preregistered coverage and reference-resampling gate.

A2.UZZI_P10.missing_definition: Null without a nondegenerate source-pair z distribution.
A2.UZZI_P10.decision_reason: Source-defined tail facet; primary admission awaits exact-null approximation and stability gates.

A2.UZZI_MEDIAN.missing_definition: Null without a nondegenerate source-pair z distribution.
A2.UZZI_MEDIAN.decision_reason: Source-defined conventionality facet, not an arbitrary alternative novelty threshold.

A2.HYPERGEOM_P10.knowledge_unit: unordered cited-source pair across strictly prior papers
A2.HYPERGEOM_P10.missing_definition: Null without at least two mapped sources, positive source marginals, and a nondegenerate exact hypergeometric variance.
A2.HYPERGEOM_P10.decision_reason: Exact analytical replacement candidate. It preserves the published paper-level P10 meaning but is explicitly not represented as the original Uzzi degree-preserving Monte Carlo null.

A2.HYPERGEOM_MEDIAN.knowledge_unit: unordered cited-source pair across strictly prior papers
A2.HYPERGEOM_MEDIAN.missing_definition: Null without at least two mapped sources, positive source marginals, and a nondegenerate exact hypergeometric variance.
A2.HYPERGEOM_MEDIAN.decision_reason: Exact analytical replacement candidate for conventionality. The null-model change from Uzzi is disclosed rather than hidden behind the original name.

A2.UZZI_MEAN.decision_reason: The source defines median conventionality, not mean; the mean is a non-source-defined centre variant.

A2.UZZI_P01.decision_reason: Published quantile variant; cannot add a primary degree of freedom beside source-defined P10.

A2.FIELD_YEAR_PERCENTILE.missing_definition: Null when source score or reference group is unavailable.
A2.FIELD_YEAR_PERCENTILE.decision_reason: Same-year percentile is a retrospective standardization and not a distinct mathematical signal.

A3.FIRST_ANY.missing_definition: Null with fewer than two mapped sources.
A3.FIRST_ANY.decision_reason: Information-losing binary variant of the first-pair incidence family.

A3.FIRST_COUNT.missing_definition: Null with fewer than two mapped sources.
A3.FIRST_COUNT.decision_reason: Mechanically scales with number of source pairs; share is the preferred incidence representative if gates pass.

A3.FIRST_SHARE.missing_definition: Null with fewer than two mapped sources.
A3.FIRST_SHARE.decision_reason: Provisional core and scale-adjusted incidence representative; independent validity is mixed and runtime gates are mandatory.

A3.FIRST_DISTANCE_SUM.missing_definition: Null when no first-time pair has a defined prior distance.
A3.FIRST_DISTANCE_SUM.decision_reason: Candidate-specific technical-debt rule: the distance-weighted family remains excluded unless the locally derived historical source distances pass the fixed overall and each-domain coverage gates; no missing value may be imputed to obtain eligibility.

A3.FIRST_DISTANCE_MEAN.missing_definition: Null when no first-time pair has a defined prior distance.
A3.FIRST_DISTANCE_MEAN.decision_reason: Known v6 technical debt: v6.1 derives the source-distance values without imputation, but this candidate remains excluded unless it passes the fixed overall and each-domain coverage gates.

A3.FUTURE_REUSED.formula: share of first-time pairs reused in future years
A3.FUTURE_REUSED.decision_reason: Uses future reuse and therefore violates the zero-leakage publication-time rule.

A4.VARIETY.missing_definition: Null when no valid reference field exists.
A4.VARIETY.decision_reason: Provisional core and direct variety representative; runtime gates pending.

A4.RELATIVE_VARIETY.missing_definition: Null when no valid reference field exists.
A4.RELATIVE_VARIETY.decision_reason: Strict positive rescaling of category count under the frozen 26-field local taxonomy; cannot be a separate primary feature.

A4.OTHER_FIELD_SHARE.knowledge_unit: reference field relative to focal field
A4.OTHER_FIELD_SHARE.missing_definition: Null without a focal field or valid reference fields.
A4.OTHER_FIELD_SHARE.decision_reason: Distinct relative-to-focal breadth family; primary admission depends on taxonomy alignment and stability.

A4.GINI_BALANCE.missing_definition: Null with no valid field; one occupied field has within-support balance one.
A4.GINI_BALANCE.decision_reason: Directly used in paper-level scientometrics and competes outcome-blindly with Pielou, Shannon and Simpson for the balance family.

A4.SHANNON.decision_reason: Valid balance-richness statistic but not scale-independent; competes within one family.

A4.PIELOU.decision_reason: Provisional core; must compete with more directly paper-applied 1-Gini and loses coverage for single-field papers.

A4.GINI_SIMPSON.decision_reason: Published paper-level balance-sensitive candidate; one balance representative only.

A4.HHI.decision_reason: Exact affine complement of Gini-Simpson and therefore cannot be an independent feature.

A4.HILL_Q1.decision_reason: Strict monotone transform of Shannon; retain only for effective-number interpretation.

A4.HILL_Q2.decision_reason: Strict monotone transform of Simpson concentration; retain only for effective-number interpretation.

A5.MEAN_DISTANCE.missing_definition: Null with fewer than two occupied fields or incomplete distance coverage.
A5.MEAN_DISTANCE.decision_reason: Provisional core and simplest unweighted disparity representative.

A5.MAX_DISTANCE.missing_definition: Null with fewer than two occupied fields.
A5.MAX_DISTANCE.decision_reason: Extreme-distance aggregation is sensitive to a single category pair and is a parameter variant of the distance family.

A5.P90_DISTANCE.missing_definition: Null with fewer than two occupied fields.
A5.P90_DISTANCE.decision_reason: Published quantile logic but a non-independent aggregation variant.

A5.RAO_STIRLING.missing_definition: Null without valid reference fields or complete required distances; one field is mathematically zero.
A5.RAO_STIRLING.decision_reason: Provisional core; eligible as the one integrated composite if outcome-blind gates pass.

A5.PORTER_INTEGRATION.decision_reason: Algebraically identical to the registered Rao-Stirling implementation.

A5.DIV.missing_definition: Null when a component is undefined.
A5.DIV.decision_reason: Legitimate competing composite under the frozen 26-field taxonomy; at most one composite can enter the primary model.

A5.DIV_STAR.decision_reason: Constant positive rescaling of DIV under the frozen 26-field taxonomy.

A5.TRUE_RS_2DS.missing_definition: Null when Rao is missing or outside [0,1).
A5.TRUE_RS_2DS.decision_reason: Strict monotone transform of Rao-Stirling; useful for interpretation, not an independent feature.

A5.LEINSTER_COBBOLD.decision_reason: At q=2 with Z=1-d it is algebraically equivalent to the registered true-Rao transform.

A5.BRIDGE_SHARE.formula: share of focal relations bridging distinct historical communities
A5.BRIDGE_SHARE.missing_definition: Null without a reproducible strictly prior community partition.
A5.BRIDGE_SHARE.decision_reason: The biomedical chemical-network unit and community procedure do not map source-faithfully to the current all-domain compact view.

A5.NETWORK_COHERENCE.formula: mean linkage strength and mean path length among focal knowledge elements
A5.NETWORK_COHERENCE.missing_definition: Null without a connected and sufficiently covered reference similarity network.
A5.NETWORK_COHERENCE.decision_reason: Published as a two-component network construct; a single source-faithful, scalable paper-level implementation is not yet frozen.

A5.SEMANTIC_DISTANCE.formula: registered quantile of cosine distances among cited-reference embeddings

parameters.embedding_model: source biomedical model unavailable as frozen cross-domain artifact

A5.SEMANTIC_DISTANCE.missing_definition: Null without title/abstract and a frozen source-faithful embedding model.
A5.SEMANTIC_DISTANCE.maximum_information_time: model and text must predate focal paper
A5.SEMANTIC_DISTANCE.decision_reason: Would require an unfrozen external text model and the source model is biomedical rather than validated across all 12 natural-science domains.

A1.CONCEPT_VOLUME_RARITY.knowledge_unit: controlled concept or concept pair in a paper
A1.CONCEPT_VOLUME_RARITY.formula: paper aggregation of inverse prior occurrence volume for concepts and concept pairs
A1.CONCEPT_VOLUME_RARITY.missing_definition: Null without publication-time controlled concepts and complete prior concept-pair history.
A1.CONCEPT_VOLUME_RARITY.decision_reason: A valid conceptual-novelty family, but it uses controlled textual concepts rather than co-cited knowledge sources and the frozen Nature view has no cross-domain controlled-vocabulary history.

A1.CONTENT_CONTEXT_SURPRISE.formula: surprise of observed content-context association relative to a historical expectation model
A1.CONTENT_CONTEXT_SURPRISE.missing_definition: Null without source-faithful content and context representations trained only on prior material.
A1.CONTENT_CONTEXT_SURPRISE.maximum_information_time: all fitted representations must stop before publication
A1.CONTENT_CONTEXT_SURPRISE.decision_reason: The construct is source-backed but is not the frozen co-cited-source rarity angle and requires external text/context representations.

A1.TOPIC_CLOUD_NOVELTY.formula: source-defined topic-model features aggregated by a fuzzy cloud novelty model
A1.TOPIC_CLOUD_NOVELTY.missing_definition: Null without paper text and a completely frozen historical topic/cloud model.
A1.TOPIC_CLOUD_NOVELTY.maximum_information_time: all fitted models must stop before publication
A1.TOPIC_CLOUD_NOVELTY.decision_reason: The topic/cloud family is outside the frozen reference-based operational angle and requires unavailable text plus trained models.

A1.LLM_TOKEN_NLL.missing_definition: Null without an abstract and a versioned model trained exclusively on information available before the paper.
A1.LLM_TOKEN_NLL.maximum_information_time: model-training corpus end must precede publication
A1.LLM_TOKEN_NLL.decision_reason: The source-backed textual-surprise family cannot be derived from the frozen citation/OpenAlex views and is not equivalent to cited-source combination rarity.

A1.HUMAN_LLM_NOVELTY.knowledge_unit: whole paper and retrieved comparison literature
A1.HUMAN_LLM_NOVELTY.formula: source-defined aggregation of human knowledge and LLM novelty judgments
A1.HUMAN_LLM_NOVELTY.missing_definition: Null without source paper text, comparison corpus, prompts, model weights and human knowledge inputs.
A1.HUMAN_LLM_NOVELTY.maximum_information_time: retrieval corpus and model knowledge must be publication-time bounded
A1.HUMAN_LLM_NOVELTY.decision_reason: This is a dynamic judgment system rather than a frozen mathematical feature and violates the local-data and fully reproducible formula rules.

A3.CONCEPT_TIME_NOVELTY.knowledge_unit: controlled concept or concept pair in a paper
A3.CONCEPT_TIME_NOVELTY.formula: paper aggregation of the age or first-observed year of concepts and concept pairs
A3.CONCEPT_TIME_NOVELTY.missing_definition: Null without complete controlled concepts and history predating the focal paper.
A3.CONCEPT_TIME_NOVELTY.decision_reason: It measures first use of controlled textual concepts rather than first co-citation of frozen knowledge sources, and no cross-domain concept history is locally frozen.

A3.NEW_COMPONENT_SHARE.formula: number of components absent from prior literature divided by focal component count
A3.NEW_COMPONENT_SHARE.missing_definition: Null without consistently extracted components and complete prior history.
A3.NEW_COMPONENT_SHARE.decision_reason: The frozen data contain cited sources and fields but not a source-faithful, cross-domain historical keyword/component view.

A3.QUESTION_METHOD_COMBINATION.formula: source-defined semantic atypicality of the focal question-method combination against prior papers
A3.QUESTION_METHOD_COMBINATION.missing_definition: Null without full text, question/method extraction and a historically frozen semantic reference set.
A3.QUESTION_METHOD_COMBINATION.maximum_information_time: all comparison papers and fitted representations must predate publication
A3.QUESTION_METHOD_COMBINATION.decision_reason: This is a valid semantic combination family but is not computable from the frozen citation/OpenAlex tables and is not the cited-source first-combination construct.

A5.FASTTEXT_LOF_SEMANTIC.knowledge_unit: paper text embedding relative to neighboring papers
A5.FASTTEXT_LOF_SEMANTIC.formula: local outlier factor of a paper embedding in the source-defined historical semantic space
A5.FASTTEXT_LOF_SEMANTIC.missing_definition: Null without paper text, historical embeddings, neighbor count and a publication-time reference set.
A5.FASTTEXT_LOF_SEMANTIC.maximum_information_time: comparison set and fitted model must predate publication
A5.FASTTEXT_LOF_SEMANTIC.decision_reason: Document-level semantic outlier status is not reference-field integration, and the required text/model artifacts are not locally frozen.

A5.LLM_SEMANTIC_GAIN.knowledge_unit: matched tokens encoded by two historical language models

parameters.models: two source-defined dBERT models with different historical context

A5.LLM_SEMANTIC_GAIN.missing_definition: Null without abstracts, aligned tokenization and both versioned historical encoders.
A5.LLM_SEMANTIC_GAIN.maximum_information_time: both model-training corpora must be publication-time bounded
A5.LLM_SEMANTIC_GAIN.decision_reason: The metric is source-backed but is a language-model representation shift, not reference-field cognitive integration, and requires unfrozen external text models.
